shells.note: shell i is drawn at (right edge - offset.x - 9) + i * step.x; count comes from mvp.json hero.shells

scale.rule: k = the world's integer device px per art px (renderer.pixelScale or the mobile device scale); the UI canvas is W/k x H/k art px; never fractional

v2.bodyFont: font (v1 Unifont atlas, 8x16, outline atlas for text over the picture)

eli.why: the owner, 13.11 ~20:15 (out of play: «כרגע יש רק אלי קופטר»): Eli's own HUD row, so nothing of the king's shows in his run (the HUD fell back to heroes.king: crowns for lives, the king's crimson). life_eli*.png: PROVISIONAL, Ben-Gurion's head icons recoloured by code to Eli's dark hair (no AI, no new drawing), until the art lane draws his own; cardColours: his suit navy and his tie red, sampled from his atlas.

rabbi.why: the rabbi (debugOnly, ?hero=rabbi; the owner, 13.11 ~21:10). His frames are his own (chars/rabbi, cut by tools/art_host/chars/rabbi_cut.py from art/skins_c/chars/rabbi/raw/98_rabbi_sheet_a); the medallion plays them. madeInIsrael.note: stamped on every weapon card, top-left inside the header (gate 3: 13 px, the smallest star; 7 and 9 px are deleted)

card.layoutNote: gate 3 (UI agent 6): the icon centred in iconBox, alone; the made-in-Israel star and the stamp in their own column right of it (they had covered the weapon); width = text + 68
card.icons: reveal.weapons.<id>.icon (48 px wide; on the card drawn from the key picture at 32 px: weapons/icon32_<id>.png)

fill.note: grows from the right as the power recharges

samovar.note: gate 3: the tank's copper samovar; frame = round((1 - hp) * 10): 10 = the tea strike (a full steam cloud); steam answers the value from frame 4; his name on hud2 plate beside it (the plate font); shudders 1 px on every tank step

cluster.medallion: right end, its top 6 px above the plate
cluster.note: gate 2: draw order plate > rail + tube > ammo on the shelf (right to left, from x W-56) > crowns at the shelf left end > ruler under the plate > medallion > nameplate; the card only for 2 s after weapon:swap

cardSwap.note: riveted under the weapon card: tab top-left = card top-left + at (it overlaps the card bottom by 2 px, drawn after the card, covering none of its content); always shown; on weapon:keyHint play frames 0/1 at 2 Hz for ticks, then frame 0; keyboard tab on desktop, touch tab on phones

identity.at: centred on the old medallion box (medallionRing w), top = medallion top + 4
identity.window: fill: rows 0-3 emblem colour x1.25, then the emblem colour to 58 % of the window, the rest x0.7 (emblem colour = heroes.<id>.cardColours[0]; a hero with no data: #46605e)
identity.head: the hero's idle frame 0 from his atlas, at the WORLD's pixel (device scale kWorld, never the UI scale): a square crop S = round(36 * opaqueHeight / 72), centred on the mean x of the opaque pixels in rows top+4 .. top+30 % of the height, its top 3 px above the opaque top; drawn bottom-aligned in the window, centred, clipped to it. It may play his own states (hurt, gloat) by the same crop.
identity.replaces: portrait / portraitFlash / medallionBack / medallionRing / nameplate (painted): they leave the shipped set once the renderer has switched

banner.note: two halves of one 1280x720 cloth; centred on the canvas, cropped by it; they slide in from the sides and part on the exit

cap.note: the left end; mirror it for the right end

peel.note: drawn at the bar's right end; the bar shortens with it

confetti.note: row = scrap kind, column = spin frame; burst from the slam point, gravity 300 art px/s², drag 0.9/s

jokeStrip.note: the whole line visible except the punchline under a censor bar (the part after the last full stop or comma, or the second half), which peels late

codenameTag.note: the codename (lines.json ui.card.<weapon>) in the plate style, readable at 1x

stampCensored.note: slam it on the censor bar the moment the bar lands over texts.strip.censored (2-3 px shake); the bar is never on screen before the line was read

rules.plate: the name plate shows texts.plate, never texts.announcer (announcerCut lines are voice only, cut by a beep)
rules.tag: the codename tag at 2x its old size, clear of the gun and the sling
rules.seam: the curtain seam is drawn behind the gun and the plate

opening.note: reading order right to left: words[0] is the rightmost. Layout: words 0-1 on the right of the star, 2-3 on its left, baseline at the band centre + 4 % of the band height; each word slams on its beat of the shout
opening.shadowRule: draw the shadow sprite at (+6, +8) art px under the word, dithered by a 4x4 Bayer threshold at 0.4 (the cloth stays visible through it); it moves with the cloth wave
opening.slam: each word: 1 f at 30 px above with 4 smear lines, then the landing frame with a 2 px band shake and a 2-frame white flash on the word, then the word rides the cloth wave (1 px every 6 columns follows the band flipbook)

top.note: its bottom 2 px overlap the cloth top edge

bottom.note: its top 2 px overlap the cloth bottom edge

rays.note: gate 2: OPAQUE (no alpha), behind the sign only; it opens by growing in 3 stepped rings (screens2_draw drawTitle), never by a fade

sign.note: gate 2: sign, logo and crown baked as one piece and tilted pixel by pixel; never rotate or scale it at run time. Cast shadow: title_sign_shadow.png (multiply).

signShadow.note: the shadow on the wall behind: draw the same frame under the sign at +6,+8 with a multiply (one flat step, no alpha ramp)

logo.note: the working title, swappable in data; baked into title_sign.png (gate 2: no visible temporary-name tag)
